question: Can a public prediction-error-gated, single-pass local state update improve predictive accuracy over identical fixed-rate local learning while retaining its cost advantage over full batch HMM EM?
seeds: SHA256 UTF8 namespace:role:family:index first 8 bytes to Python random.Random
public_interface: At timestep t only o_t,a_t and public prior history can predict o_(t+1). The generator's latent binary state, role, and family are NEVER learner features. Target o_(t+1) is used solely for training update after predictive output.

INNOVATION_GATED_ONLINE.model: O5 two-latent-state public Bayesian filter with prescribed structure
INNOVATION_GATED_ONLINE.gating: g = clamp(0.5 + 2*abs(y_t+1 - p_t+1_preobs), 0.5, 1.5); both emission and transition local updates multiplied by g; p from model prediction before target reveal

GATED_FIXED_TRANSITION_ABLATION.model: identical innovation gated model without transition parameter training

frozen_decision.primary: Report signed mean next-public-bit NLL for every arm, A,B,NULL. Positive comparative gain = benchmark NLL minus candidate NLL.
frozen_decision.cpu: Fit+SELECT CPU including two starts for locally trained arms and batch HMM; CPU comparison apples-to-apples within same native OS; state bytes per candidate, training and DEV inference separately.
frozen_decision.selection: All initialization selection on O6_PUBLIC_SELECT only. Never fit or select on O6_PUBLIC_DEV.

frozen_decision.cross_os: All 9 role/family SHA256 source digests exactly identical and 18 family/arm NLL outputs within 1e-6 Windows vs Linux.
frozen_decision.success_boundary: Promote no candidate based only on O6 PUBLIC_DEV. A candidate should show both causal family accuracy and resource competitive results against strongest conventional and ablation before integration consideration; scientific first-use remains independently blocked.
frozen_decision.negatives: Record all signed gains, null results, violations, failures and budgets; never retune this frozen identity after reviewing DEV.
